preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through social engineering/compromise)
Contract must be initialized and trading enabled

exploit_hint: As owner, call setWallets() to change marketing/development wallets to attacker-controlled addresses, then trigger contractSwap() via a sell transaction to divert ETH fees to attacker wallets. Alternatively, use sweepContingency() before liquidity is added, or manipulate taxes/ratios to extract maximum value from traders.
